
```{r, results = "asis", echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

cat("## Neural Network", "\n\n")
cat("Neural network formed by", input$nLayers, "layers:", "\n\n")
if (input$layerType1 != "")
{if (input$layerType1 == "Dropout") {cat("Layer n° 1 is a", input$layerType1, "layer, with a", input$dropout1, "dropout value.", "\n\n")} else
  {cat("Layer n° 1 is a", input$layerType1, "layer, with", input$neurons1, "neurons and a", input$activation, "activation function.", "\n\n")}}
if (input$layerType2 != "")
{if (input$layerType2 == "Dropout") {cat("Layer n° 2 is a", input$layerType2, "layer, with a", input$dropout2, "dropout value.", "\n\n")} else
  {cat("Layer n° 2 is a", input$layerType2, "layer, with", input$neurons2, "neurons and a", input$activation, "activation function.", "\n\n")}}
if (input$layerType3 != "")
{if (input$layerType3 == "Dropout") {cat("Layer n° 3 is a", input$layerType3, "layer, with a", input$dropout3, "dropout value.", "\n\n")} else
  {cat("Layer n° 3 is a", input$layerType3, "layer, with", input$neurons3, "neurons and a", input$activation, "activation function.", "\n\n")}}
if (input$layerType4 != "")
{if (input$layerType4 == "Dropout") {cat("Layer n° 4 is a", input$layerType4, "layer, with a", input$dropout4, "dropout value.", "\n\n")} else
  {cat("Layer n° 4 is a", input$layerType4, "layer, with", input$neurons4, "neurons and a", input$activation, "activation function.", "\n\n")}}
if (input$layerType5 != "")
{if (input$layerType5 == "Dropout") {cat("Layer n° 5 is a", input$layerType5, "layer, with a", input$dropout5, "dropout value.", "\n\n")} else
  {cat("Layer n° 5 is a", input$layerType5, "layer, with", input$neurons5, "neurons and a", input$activation, "activation function.", "\n\n")}}

cat("The network learning parameter has been set at a value of", input$learnParam, "meanwhile the maximum number of epochs for each run has been set at a value of", input$nEpochs, "epochs.", "\n\n")

if (length(testfit_results) > 0 | length(traintest_results) > 0) {cat("## Test Phase", "\n\n")}
if (length(testfit_results) > 0) {
  cat("# Model Fit on whole dataset", "\n\n")
  cat("The final chronological block is used for validation and early stopping; the selected epoch count is then used to refit the model on the whole available dataset.", "\n\n")
}

if (length(traintest_results) > 0) {
  cat("# Test on observed years", "\n\n")
  report_split <- temporalSplitDefinition(
    nrow(neuralNetInputs) - as.integer(input$depthTest)
  )
  cat(
    "Recursive holdout test on the last", input$depthTest,
    "years, based on 30 reproducible initializations. The adaptive temporal split uses",
    report_split$lookback, "lookback year(s),", report_split$n_training,
    "training target(s) and", report_split$n_validation,
    paste(
      "validation target(s). The neural network predicts the complete",
      "abundance-at-age vector under a pre-holdout reference F. Each held-out",
      "vector is corrected from reference F to historical source-year F; the",
      "terminal plus-group uses a weighted two-source correction. Held-out",
      "catches are reconstructed with the Baranov equation rather than read",
      "from observations."
    ),
    "\n\n"
  )
  if (isTRUE(report_split$short_series)) {
    cat("**Short-series warning:** this run is exploratory because fewer than eight supervised training targets are available.", "\n\n")
  }
  for (i in seq_along(traintest_plots)) {
    sp <- species[[i]]
    cat("Results for", sp)
    print(traintest_plots[[i]])
    print(taylor_diagram[[i]])
    cat("\n\n")
  }
    print(traintest_metrics_plot)
}

cat("\\newpage")

if (length(f_tot) > 0) {
  cat("## Forecast Phase", "\n\n")
  
  cat("Fishing Mortality baseline and first applied scenario year (estimated over the last", fmort_baseline, "years):", "\n\n")
  mortality_summary <- f_tot
  if (length(pred_results) > 0 && nrow(f_applied) > 0L) {
    first_applied <- f_applied[1L, -1L, drop = FALSE]
    mortality_summary <- t(rbind(
      f_new, first_applied, round(first_applied / f_new, 2)
    ))
    colnames(mortality_summary) <- c("Calculated", "Adjusted", "Multiplier")
    rownames(mortality_summary) <- gsub("_F", "_GSA", rownames(mortality_summary))
  }
  print(knitr::kable(mortality_summary, digits = 3))
  cat("\n\n")
  
  if (length(pred_results) > 0) {
    cat("Fishing mortality used for the plotted forecast:", "\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(f_applied, digits = 3))
    cat("\n\n")
    n_iterations <- if (is.data.frame(pred_iter_partial) && "iter" %in% names(pred_iter_partial)) {
      length(unique(pred_iter_partial$iter))
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
    cat(
      "Counterfactual prediction on", depth_pred, "years after", n_iterations,
      paste(
        "independent initialization(s). The neural network supplies the full",
        "abundance-at-age vector under reference F. Relative-survival factors",
        "map every non-recruit abundance to scenario F; Baranov catches and",
        "spawning-time SSB use the same selected scenario:"
      ),
      "\n\n"
    )
    
    for (i in seq_along(pred_results)) {

      subpred <- pred_results[[i]]
      
      pred <- as.numeric(subpred$ssb_mean[nrow(subpred)])
      observed_row <- which(
        subpred$type == "Observed" &
          subpred$year == max(neuralNetInputs$year)
      )
      obs <- as.numeric(subpred$ssb_mean[utils::tail(observed_row, 1L)])
    
      if (!is.finite(obs) || obs <= 0) {
        cat("The percentage change in SSB cannot be calculated because the last observed SSB is not positive.")
      } else if (pred > obs) {
        cat("The SSB of", subpred$species[1], "in year", max(subpred$year), "increases by",
            (round(pred/obs, 2) * 100 - 100), "percent")
        } else {
          cat("The SSB of", subpred$species[1], "in year", max(subpred$year), "decreases by",
              (round(pred/obs, 2) * 100 - 100) * (-1), "percent")
        }
    
      cat("\n\n")
      print(plotPred(subpred, neuralNetInputs, i))
    
      cat("Stock/Recruitment Ratio for", subpred$species[1], "\n\n")
      print(plotRecruitment(subpred, i, as.integer(depth_pred)))
      cat("\n\n\\newpage\n")
      }
    }
  }

if(length(sens_results) > 0) {
  cat("## Sensitivity analysis", "\n\n")
  cat("Finite-difference sensitivity is reported across the complete neural-network abundance-at-age output vector; scenario-F corrections are applied after the neural prediction.", "\n\n")
  plotSensAnalysis(sens_results)
  }
```
